{{Quote|Vanguards focus on short range combat maneuvers that keep them up close and personal. Plus they get all the latest defensive tech&mdash;they're like walking fortresses.|Lieutenant [[Ballard]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Vanguard advanced training program''' was a training program in the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. [[Republic trooper|Troopers]] who underwent the Vanguard program specialized in short-range weapons, such as [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], and defensive technology.

==Behind the scenes==
The vanguard is an advanced class for the trooper class in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' MMO video game. This advanced class specializes in [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] rifles, defensive [[Ray shield/Legends|shielding]], and absorbing damage in combat. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] counterpart for this archetype is the [[powertech]].
